thesis: The hosts present a remastered episode of the Acquired podcast about the business of the National Football League, updating the original 2023 content with new developments in streaming, international strategy, gambling, and private equity. The episode begins by tracing the sport's origins from a violent, uncodified game in 1869 to its formalization in American colleges, noting that the forward pass was not part of the early game.
